name: fortios_reorder_keyed_stable
intended:

    set hostname "FortiGate-01"
    set timezone 04
end
config firewall address
    edit "server-a"
        set type ipmask
        set subnet 10.0.1.10 255.255.255.255
    next
    edit "server-b"
        set type ipmask
        set subnet 10.0.1.20 255.255.255.255
    next
end
